claim: In the matching retail DLL, FormAnimator.UpdateAnimation (0x06004E7E) reads FormAnimator.reqAnmInit, conditionally calls FormAnimator.InitAnimation (0x06004E73), then stores zero back to reqAnmInit. InitAnimation reads this.plObj.TargetPlIdx and passes it to PlayerMan.GetPlObj, and its method body contains direct call sites to FormAnimator.StartAnm, FormAnimator.StartOpponentAnm, and FormAnimator.StartOpponentAnmM. In verified R6 raw capture bytes, 5288/5288 InitAnimation PRE calls pair with POST calls; every observed invocation contains exactly one direct StartAnm call with raw argument 0. 802 observed invocations also contain one direct StartOpponentAnm where the first raw argument equals the InitAnimation parent target and the nested request owner_slot equals that same target; 68 of those additionally contain one direct StartOpponentAnmM where raw argument 3 equals the InitAnimation parent target and the nested request owner_slot equals StartOpponentAnmM raw argument 1.
